answer: A farm of 375 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in violet, queued in mesa, and reef publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 24 identities per epoch. A farm of 1804 identities would post 3385 proofs and burn roughly 4 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
